description: Interactive filter program for any kind of list.

option.name: --man
tip: Show man page.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

global_option.name: --accept-nth
tip: Define which fields to print on accept.

global_option.name: --ansi
tip: Enable processing of ANSI color codes.

global_option.name: --bash
tip: Print script to set up Bash shell integration.

global_option.name: --bind
tip: Custom key/event bindings.

global_option.name: --border
tip: Draw border around the finder.

global_option.name: --border-label
tip: Label to print on the border.

global_option.name: --border-label-pos
tip: Position of the border label.

global_option.name: --color
tip: Base scheme and/or custom colors.

global_option.name: --cycle
tip: Enable cyclic scroll.

global_option.name: --delimiter
tip: Field delimiter regex (default: AWK-style).

global_option.name: --disabled
tip: Do not perform search.

global_option.name: --ellipsis
tip: Ellipsis to show when line is truncated.

global_option.name: --exact
tip: Enable exact-match.

global_option.name: --exit-0
tip: Exit immediately when there's no match.

global_option.name: --expect
tip: Comma-separated list of keys to complete fzf.

global_option.name: --filepath-word
tip: Make word-wise movements respect path separators.

global_option.name: --filter
tip: Print matches for the initial query and exit.

global_option.name: --fish
tip: Print script to set up Fish shell integration.

global_option.name: --footer
tip: String to print as footer.

global_option.name: --footer-border
tip: Draw border around the footer section.

global_option.name: --footer-label
tip: Label to print on the footer border.

global_option.name: --footer-label-pos
tip: Position of the footer label.

global_option.name: --freeze-left
tip: Number of fields to freeze on the left.

global_option.name: --freeze-right
tip: Number of fields to freeze on the right.

global_option.name: --gap
tip: Render empty lines between each item.

global_option.name: --gap-line
tip: Draw horizontal line on each gap using the string.

global_option.name: --ghost
tip: Ghost text to display when the input is empty.

global_option.name: --gutter
tip: Character used for the gutter column.

global_option.name: --gutter-raw
tip: Character used for the gutter column in raw mode.

global_option.name: --header
tip: String to print as header.

global_option.name: --header-border
tip: Draw border around the header section.

global_option.name: --header-first
tip: Print header before the prompt line.

global_option.name: --header-label
tip: Label to print on the header border.

global_option.name: --header-label-pos
tip: Position of the header label.

global_option.name: --header-lines
tip: The first N lines of the input are treated as header.

global_option.name: --header-lines-border
tip: Display header from --header-lines with a separate border.
Pass 'none' to still separate it but without a border.
Pass 'inline' to embed it inside the list frame.

global_option.name: --height
tip: Display fzf window below the cursor with the given height.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show help message.

global_option.name: --highlight-line
tip: Highlight the whole current line.

global_option.name: --history
tip: File to store fzf search history.

global_option.name: --history-size
tip: Maximum number of entries to keep in the file.

global_option.name: --hscroll-off
tip: Number of screen columns to keep to the right.

global_option.name: --id-nth
tip: Define item identity fields for cross-reload operations.

global_option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Case-insensitive match.

global_option.name: --info
tip: Finder info style.

global_option.name: --info-command
tip: Command to generate info line.

global_option.name: --input-border
tip: Draw border around the input section.

global_option.name: --input-label
tip: Label to print on the input border.

global_option.name: --input-label-pos
tip: Position of the input label.

global_option.name: --jump-labels
tip: Label characters for jump mode.

global_option.name: --keep-right
tip: Keep the right end of the line visible on overflow.

global_option.name: --layout
tip: Choose layout.

global_option.name: --list-border
tip: Draw border around the list section.

global_option.name: --list-label
tip: Label to print on the list border.

global_option.name: --list-label-pos
tip: Position of the list label.

global_option.name: --listen
tip: Start HTTP server to receive actions via TCP.

global_option.name: --literal
tip: Do not normalize latin script letters.

global_option.name: --margin
tip: Screen margin (TRBL | TB,RL | T,RL,B | T,R,B,L).

global_option.name: --marker
tip: Multi-select marker.

global_option.name: --marker-multi-line
tip: Multi-select marker for multi-line entries; 3 elements for top, middle, and bottom.

global_option.name: --min-height
tip: Minimum height when --height is given as a percentage.

global_option.name: --multi
tip: Enable multi-select with tab/shift-tab.

global_option.name: --no-bold
tip: Do not use bold text.

global_option.name: --no-color
tip: Disable colors.

global_option.name: --no-extended
tip: Disable extended-search mode.

global_option.name: --no-hscroll
tip: Disable horizontal scroll.

global_option.name: --no-ignore-case
tip: Case-sensitive match.

global_option.name: --no-input
tip: Disable and hide the input section.

global_option.name: --no-multi-line
tip: Disable multi-line display of items when using --read0.

global_option.name: --no-scrollbar
tip: Hide scrollbar.

global_option.name: --no-separator
tip: Hide info line separator.

global_option.name: --no-sort
tip: Do not sort the result.

global_option.name: --nth
tip: Comma-separated list of field index expressions for limiting search scope.

global_option.name: --nushell
tip: Print script to set up Nushell integration.

global_option.name: --padding
tip: Padding inside border.

global_option.name: --pointer
tip: Pointer to the current line.

global_option.name: --popup
tip: Start fzf in a popup window.

global_option.name: --preview
tip: Command to preview highlighted line ({})...

global_option.name: --preview-border
tip: Short for --preview-window=border-STYLE.

global_option.name: --preview-label
tip: Label to print on the preview border.

global_option.name: --preview-label-pos
tip: Position of the preview label.

global_option.name: --preview-window
tip: Preview window layout.

global_option.name: --preview-wrap-sign
tip: Indicator for wrapped lines in the preview window.

global_option.name: --print-query
tip: Print query as the first line.

global_option.name: --print0
tip: Print output delimited by ASCII NUL characters.

global_option.name: --prompt
tip: Input prompt (default: '> ').

global_option.name: --query
tip: Start the finder with the given query.

global_option.name: --raw
tip: Enable raw mode (show non-matching items).

global_option.name: --read0
tip: Read input delimited by ASCII NUL characters.

global_option.name: --scheme
tip: Scoring scheme.

global_option.name: --scroll-off
tip: Number of screen lines to keep above or below when scrolling.

global_option.name: --scrollbar
tip: Scrollbar character(s).

global_option.name: --select-1
tip: Automatically select the only match.

global_option.name: --separator
tip: Draw horizontal separator on info line.

global_option.name: --smart-case
tip: Smart-case match (default).

global_option.name: --style
tip: Apply a style preset.

global_option.name: --sync
tip: Synchronous search for multi-staged filtering.

global_option.name: --tabstop
tip: Number of spaces for a tab character.

global_option.name: --tac
tip: Reverse the order of the input.

global_option.name: --tail
tip: Maximum number of items to keep in memory.

global_option.name: --tiebreak
tip: Sort criteria when scores are tied.

global_option.name: --tmux
tip: Alias for --popup.

global_option.name: --track
tip: Track the current selection when the result is updated.

global_option.name: --walker
tip: Directory traversal options.

global_option.name: --walker-root
tip: List of directories to walk.

global_option.name: --walker-skip
tip: Comma-separated list of directory names to skip.

global_option.name: --with-nth
tip: Transform the presentation of each line using field index expressions.

global_option.name: --with-shell
tip: Shell command and flags to start child processes with.

global_option.name: --wrap
tip: Enable line wrap.

global_option.name: --wrap-sign
tip: Indicator for wrapped lines.

global_option.name: --zsh
tip: Print script to set up Zsh shell integration.
